cases.title: CDPROFILE asks for a starting pit, takes pit P3 and opens the Profiles window; closing it leaves nothing drawn
cases.reviewed_against: builder-filled: Opus review still needed. Compared by the builder on 25 Oct 2026 with triage group Q1 only (the first prompt of CDPROFILE and the window that the accepted pick opens). No long-section value and no Q1 bug text is proved.
cases.expected: CDPROFILE asks 'Select starting CE pit for profile review:'. With the view zoomed to pit P3, a pick 200 mm to the right of the pit's insertion point is accepted (CE does not say 'Select a CE pit block.'), the window 'Creative Engineering | Profiles (CDPROFILE)' opens, closing it leaves no CE window, and the object count and the file on disk do not change.
cases.why_not_unit: The prompts and the long-section values come from the real drawing.
not_automated: THE DRAWN LONG SECTION IS NOT DRIVEN: datum, grade, depth, cover and rows (BUG-542, BUG-599, BUG-757 to BUG-759, BUG-761 to BUG-763, BUG-768, BUG-769) need the profile to be placed; only the start of the route (the first prompt, an accepted pit pick and the window that opens) is checked.
What the Profiles window lists and what its buttons do are not read or pressed.
